clauses.name: disease_sub_limits
clauses.explanation: The policy limits cataract treatment payments to 15 % of the Sum Insured, with a maximum of INR 25,000 per eye, and excludes coverage for the first two years after policy commencement.
clauses.evidence: Cataract Treatment: Our obligation to make payment in respect of any claim for treatment of Cataract including surgery thereof under the policy is limited to 15 % of the Sum Insured subject to a maximum of INR 25000 per eye and further subject to first two years exclusion for cataract as provided under the Policy.
